\begin{tikzpicture}[mcsstyle]

% ---- B: reaction scheme -------------------------------------------------
\begin{scope}[shift={(0,0)}]
\node[paneltag] at (-0.28,2.43) {A};

\coordinate (aCl1) at (0.90,1.20);
\coordinate (aCl2) at (2.10,1.20);
\draw[breakbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (aCl1)--(aCl2);
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (aCl1) {Cl};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (aCl2) {Cl};
\node at (3.10,1.20) {$+$};

\ringcoords{5.00,1.20}{A}
\coordinate (AH) at ($(AA)+(1.05,0)$);
\drawring{A}
\draw[breakbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=3pt] (AA)--(AH);
\node[elem] at (AH) {H};

\draw[rxnarrow] (3.05,0.25) -- (3.05,-1.00);

\coordinate (bH)  at (0.95,-1.90);
\coordinate (bCl) at (2.05,-1.90);
\draw[formbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (bH)--(bCl);
\node[elem] at (bH) {H};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (bCl) {Cl};
\node at (3.10,-1.90) {$+$};

\ringcoords{5.00,-1.90}{B}
\coordinate (BCl) at ($(AB)+(1.05,0)$);
\drawring{B}
\draw[formbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (AB)--(BCl);
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (BCl) {Cl};

\begin{scope}[shift={(0.55,-3.06)}]
  \draw[breakbond] (0.00,0.00) -- (0.48,0.00);
  \node[anchor=west, font=\scriptsize] at (0.62,0.00) {cleaved \((1,0)\)};
  \draw[formbond] (0.00,-0.38) -- (0.48,-0.38);
  \node[anchor=west, font=\scriptsize] at (0.62,-0.38) {formed \((0,1)\)};
  \node[maptag] at (0.24,-0.76) {i};
  \node[anchor=west, font=\scriptsize] at (0.62,-0.76) {atom-map index};
\end{scope}
\end{scope}

% ---- C: mapped reactant / product / ITS ---------------------------------
\begin{scope}[shift={(8.40,0.10)}]
\node[paneltag] at (-0.28,2.33) {B};

\def\leftx{1.55}
\def\rowA{1.20}
\def\rowB{-1.80}
\def\rowC{-4.85}
\def\hx{4.10}
\def\cllx{3.00}
\def\clrx{4.35}
\def\topy{0.98}

\ringcoords{\leftx,\rowA}{R}
\ringcoords{\leftx,\rowB}{P}
\ringcoords{\leftx,\rowC}{I}

\coordinate (RH)   at (\hx,\rowA);
\coordinate (RCl3) at (\cllx,\rowA+\topy);
\coordinate (RCl4) at (\clrx,\rowA+\topy);
\coordinate (PH)   at (\hx,\rowB);
\coordinate (PCl3) at (\cllx,\rowB+\topy);
\coordinate (PCl4) at (\clrx,\rowB+\topy);
\coordinate (IH)   at (\hx,\rowC);
\coordinate (ICl3) at (\cllx,\rowC+\topy);
\coordinate (ICl4) at (\clrx,\rowC+\topy);

\draw[mapguide] (AR) -- (AP) -- (AI);
\draw[mapguide] (RH) -- (PH) -- (IH);
\draw[mapguide] (RCl3) -- (PCl3) -- (ICl3);
\draw[mapguide] (RCl4) -- (PCl4) -- (ICl4);

\node[rowlabel] at (0.20,\rowA+1.25) {Reactant};
\node[rowlabel] at (0.20,\rowB+1.25) {Product};
\node[rowlabel] at (0.20,\rowC+1.25) {ITS};

\draw[rxnarrow] (2.55,0.35) -- (2.55,-0.80);

\drawring{R}
\draw[breakbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=3pt] (AR)--(RH);
\draw[breakbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (RCl3)--(RCl4);
\node[elem] at (RH) {H};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (RCl3) {Cl};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (RCl4) {Cl};
\maplabel{AR}{0.18,-0.18}{1}
\maplabel{RH}{0.16,0.18}{2}
\maplabel{RCl3}{0,0.25}{3}
\maplabel{RCl4}{0,0.25}{4}

\drawring{P}
\draw[formbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (AP)--(PCl3);
\draw[formbond,shorten <=3pt,shorten >=2pt] (PH)--(PCl4);
\node[elem] at (PH) {H};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (PCl3) {Cl};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (PCl4) {Cl};
\maplabel{AP}{0.18,-0.18}{1}
\maplabel{PH}{0.16,0.18}{2}
\maplabel{PCl3}{0,0.25}{3}
\maplabel{PCl4}{0,0.25}{4}

\drawring{I}
\draw[keepbond] (AI)--(BI)--(CI)--(DI)--(EI)--(FI)--cycle;
\draw[breakbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=3pt] (AI)-- node[statetag,pos=.52,below] {(1,0)} (IH);
\draw[breakbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (ICl3)-- node[statetag,pos=.50,above] {(1,0)} (ICl4);
\draw[formbond,shorten <=2pt,shorten >=2pt] (AI)-- node[statetag,pos=.50,left] {(0,1)} (ICl3);
\draw[formbond,shorten <=3pt,shorten >=2pt] (IH)-- node[statetag,pos=.50,right] {(0,1)} (ICl4);
\node[elem] at (IH) {H};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (ICl3) {Cl};
\node[elem,text=green!42!black] at (ICl4) {Cl};
\maplabel{AI}{0.18,-0.18}{1}
\maplabel{IH}{0.16,0.18}{2}
\maplabel{ICl3}{0,0.25}{3}
\maplabel{ICl4}{0,0.25}{4}
\end{scope}

\end{tikzpicture}
